turns.text: You maintain the light registry for the coast watch. Record: the beacon on Thornwick Hill flashes white; the beacon on Marlow Cliff flashes red. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
Registry update: after repainting its lenses, the beacon on Thornwick Hill now flashes green, not white. The beacon on Marlow Cliff is unchanged. Acknowledge in one line.
A sailor asks, registry not at hand: what color does the beacon on Thornwick Hill flash? Answer with just the color.
